# distribution

<!-- Generated by TestProjectDocsFresh (PRUFYX_UPDATE_DOCS=1 go test ./internal/communityapp -run TestProjectDocsFresh). Do not edit. -->

Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project distribution --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project distribution`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project distribution --image-manifest FILE --from 2.8.3 --to 3.0.0 (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--image-manifest-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project distribution --input FILE --from 2.8.3 --to 3.0.0 [--input-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
